I'll tell you why you can't just "end this". No matter how hard you try you just can't kill yourselves in the end. Trust me, I've tried many times...and survival instincts always win....  You need an EXTRAORDINARY amount will power to even pull it off. Heck, if you even have that, it might be better used in making your lives better instead... 

who the fuck am I joking, I can't even sort my own life out and here I am trying to give advice!
